item.blurb: Lawvek Raises $550,000 Pre-seed. Lawvek raises $550K pre-seed funding led by Neon Fund to expand its enterprise AI platform for vendor billing management and cost recovery.
Backgrounder Raises $2M Pre-seed. Backgrounder raises $2 million in pre-seed funding led by Paladin Capital Group to expand its AI platform for preventing scams and digital impersonation.
Sequent raises $2.2M pre-seed round, lands Curve as first client - Crypto Briefing. Sequent raises $2.2M pre-seed round, lands Curve as first client  Crypto Briefing
Rialto Raises $5M Seed. Rialto raises $5 million in a seed round co-led by Robinhood and Tandem to scale its onchain trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized assets.
Umber Raises $2M Seed. Umber raises $2 million in seed funding to expand its digital asset as a service platform for businesses managing large volumes of content.
OpenVault Raises $2M Seed. OpenVault raises $2M in a seed round led by HorizonArc Ventures to expand its AI-powered digital asset yield management platform.
whereable.ai Raises $2.26M Pre-Series A. whereable.ai raises $2.26 million in a pre-Series A funding round to advance its autonomous driving software for industrial and logistics environments.

Every raises $17.5 million at $110 million valuation, betting venture-backed media can work. Every, an AI-focused media company and publication, has raised $17.5 million at a $110 million post-money valuation, Fortune has exclusively learned.
Bayesline Raises $4M in Funding. Bayesline raises $4 million in an institutional funding round led by Nyca Partners to expand its GPU-powered financial analytics platform for asset managers.
Bound Raises $50M Debt Financing. Bound secures $50M in debt financing from Viola Credit to scale its AI-powered foreign exchange risk management platform for mid-market companies.
